audience: teams that keep contract and contact records in an Agiloft knowledgebase

useCases.title: Find the table that holds a record type
useCases.text: List the tables of the knowledgebase with their logical names. Ask for the fields of one table to see which columns it has.

useCases.title: Search a table for matching records
useCases.text: Run an ad hoc query on one table and read the match count and the fields you request. Page through large results with page and limit.

useCases.title: Open the full record behind a search result
useCases.text: Get one record by table and id, with every field the knowledgebase user can see. Use it to read the details of a search hit.
